keys.gp_intro: Buttons, sticks, triggers and supported USB features.
keys.gp_measure_hint: Release both sticks for a rest measurement, then rotate them slowly for circle coverage.
keys.gp_buttons_hint: Press and release every button. Move both triggers through their full range.
keys.gp_rate_note: Input packet rate is measured locally. It is not your screen or game frame rate.
keys.gp_calib_intro: USB calibration is available only for verified Sony models and firmware. Temporary changes reset when the controller powers off.
keys.gp_step1_hint: Measure rest and circle coverage before making changes.
keys.gp_step2_hint: Center adjusts rest position; range adjusts end points. Each can be performed separately.
keys.gp_center_0: Move both sticks to the top-left corner, then release. Wait for them to return to center.
keys.gp_center_1: Move both sticks to the top-right corner, then release. Wait for center.
keys.gp_center_2: Move both sticks to the bottom-left corner, then release. Wait for center.
keys.gp_center_3: Move both sticks to the bottom-right corner, then release. Wait for center.
keys.gp_center_wait: Move both sticks to the indicated corner, then release them.
keys.gp_range_hint: Rotate each stick slowly around its outside edge. A turn counts after nearly all directions are covered.
keys.gp_range_wait: Complete four full circles with each stick.
keys.gp_temp_done: Temporary calibration applied. Measure after and repeat circles.
keys.gp_step3_hint: Compare before and after. If the result is correct, enter SAVE. Do not disconnect USB while writing.
keys.gp_saving: Writing controller memory… Keep USB connected.
keys.gp_saved: The controller confirmed the write. Export the report, reconnect and repeat the test to verify persistence.
keys.gp_save_need: Saving requires temporary calibration, after measurements, full circles and the word SAVE.
keys.gp_no_sony: DS4, DualSense and DualSense Edge calibration requires USB. Connect Sony using the button above. Other controllers support input tests.
keys.gp_replug: Session closed. Power off and reconnect the controller to reset temporary changes.
keys.gp_unsaved: Temporary changes are not saved. Export the report; powering off resets unsaved calibration.
keys.gp_license_text: Interface and measurements by RemTeh. Sony protocol by DualShock Tools, MIT. Working files are bundled locally.
keys.gp_thresholds: Reference thresholds: center {center}%, noise {noise}%, circle error {circle}%. These are guides, not a replacement for practical testing.
keys.gp_touch_hint: Sony USB reports show two touches and controller motion.
keys.gp_result_hint: The report contains measurements and the comparison image. Exporting a report does not write calibration.
keys.gp_comparison_hint: Before and after refer to the same controller connection.
keys.gp_circle_hint: Rotate each stick around the full outside edge.
keys.gp_save_confirm: Enter SAVE to confirm a permanent calibration write.
keys.gp_error_generic: Operation did not finish. Check the connection and device permission.
keys.gp_error_usb_required: Calibration requires a USB data cable. Bluetooth supports ordinary input tests.
keys.gp_error_no_input: No controller input. Check the cable and close other apps using it.
keys.gp_error_unsupported_device: Model, authenticity or firmware verification failed. Calibration is blocked; input testing remains available.
keys.gp_error_memory_unlocked: Temporary memory mode was not confirmed. Power off and reconnect before trying again.
keys.gp_error_battery_unknown: Fresh reliable battery information is unavailable. Calibration and permanent writes are blocked.
keys.gp_error_battery_low: Battery is below 30%. Charge the controller before calibration.
keys.gp_error_disconnected: Controller disconnected. Measurements for that connection were cleared.
keys.gp_error_reconnect_required: Session stopped after an error. Power off and reconnect before continuing.
keys.gp_error_protocol_failed: The controller did not confirm calibration. Success was not recorded. Power off and reconnect.
keys.gp_error_flash_failed: The controller did not confirm the write. Do not assume calibration was saved.
keys.gp_error_measurements_required: Before and after measurements must belong to one connection and the latest calibration.
keys.gp_error_measurement: Measurement interrupted: insufficient data or hidden tab. Repeat it.
keys.gp_error_busy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
keys.gp_error_load: Calibration module could not load. Input tests remain available.
keys.gp_error_sticks_moving: The sticks are moving. Release them; reconnect after an interrupted calibration.
keys.gp_error_feature_unavailable: This feature is unavailable for this model or operating system.
keys.gp_error_confirmation_required: For permanent writing enter SAVE, exactly in uppercase.
keys.gp_error_no_changes: No new temporary calibration is available to save.
keys.gp_error_persistent_save_unverified: This model cannot verify all 12 parameters before a permanent write. Temporary calibration is available; permanent writing is blocked.
keys.gp_circle_warn: Circle error is above the reference threshold
keys.gp_drift_warn: Center offset is above the reference threshold
keys.gp_no_hid: USB calibration needs a compatible browser or the Deckivo Android USB adapter. Ordinary input testing is available.
keys.gp_noise_warn: Stick noise is above the reference threshold
keys.gp_rumble_none: Vibration is unavailable through this connection
keys.gp_rumble_ok: Command completed; confirm the physical vibration yourself
keys.gp_sticks_ok: Stick measurements are within the reference thresholds
